unit.why: A second, self-contained version, sent in a letter, of how R. Lipa gave ten years of his life to his sick brother R. Zvi of Zhidachov and died, followed by family memories.
unit.boundary_note: Ends with the heading of the next section ('מערכת ז. זקינינו הרה"ק ר׳ יודא צבי מראזלא'), which belongs to the next division; the story is a variant of the version that ends the previous division.

stories.start_quote: ואמנם ש"ב הרה״ג חו״פ בנש"ק מוהר"נ ערליך
stories.end_quote: ולדעתי אין סתירה בין ב׳ נוסחאות אלו
stories.summary_en: When R. Zvi of Zhidachov fell ill, his brother R. Lipa gave him ten years of his own life on condition that Zvi look after his children; Lipa went home and died, Zvi recovered, and the families cared for Lipa's descendants, as the writer's grandmother Rivkahle recounted.

quotes: נכנס אליו אחיו הרב ר׳ ליפא ז"ל
מזקנתי הצדיקת רבקהלי ע"ה [בת רבינו צבי]
tags.why: The brother, daughter and descendants of the tzaddik are the characters.

quotes: נסע אחיו הרב ר׳ ליפא לביתו ונסתלק לעולמו
tags.why: R. Lipa's death is the central event.

quotes: אנכי נותן לך במתנה עשרה שנים מן שנותי
tags.why: R. Lipa averts R. Zvi's death by giving up his own years.
R. Zvi recovers from his illness through the exchange.

quotes: אחי רבי אתה נצרך לעלמא הדין
tags.why: R. Lipa saves his brother from death.

quotes: וכן הי׳ שבאותו פרק נסע אחיו
tags.why: The gift of years takes effect supernaturally.
The tzaddik's life is needed by thousands of Jews.

quotes: והי׳ לו מס"נ עליהם באיזה ענינים
tags.why: Self-sacrifice and the family's devoted care for the orphans.

quotes: זאת שמעתי כ״פ מזקנתי הצדיקת רבקהלי
tags.why: The text frames the story as an oral family account passed on in a letter.

quotes: ההשגחה מזקנתי צורת רבקהלי הנ"ל על מרת חיה
tags.why: Rivkahle tells the story and looks after Chaya.

quotes: ואחת מהם חיה שמה ואנכי ראיתיה
tags.why: Chaya and the other daughters are only mentioned.

family genealogy and care for orphaned descendants
reconciling variant versions of the same story (textual tradition)
